meta.subject: Social Science
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Standard Six Social Science Term I 2025 English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.extraction_policy: Source-exhaustive bilingual framing from classroom narrative, ancient-town map, Poompuhar trade/literary evidence, Madurai Sangam/market/foreign-account evidence, Kanchi education/temples/water management, ancient Tamil regions and sayings, summary/glossary, evaluation, HOTS, activities, answer grid and map work. Outside corrections are not silently inserted.
source_notes: Both English and Tamil 2025 Term I books were used. Unit 4 uses printed pages 149–157 in both editions.
The opening Tamilagam map was inspected visually, but the bank relies primarily on the clearly printed town names and lesson text rather than ambiguous cartographic placement.
The chapter describes Mesopotamian civilisation as the earliest civilisation and '6500 years old'; that source wording is preserved as textbook content.
Where the exercise asks broad open-ended items, the question bank keeps answers within evidence explicitly supplied by this chapter instead of importing outside details.
The Tamil and English texts differ slightly in phrasing around some trade items; bilingual questions preserve the common source-supported meaning.
